notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749585/6d0d25bd63e63511bc650c7a1d262cf6b831a84f.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Tormenture receives a major update[/b][/h2]

We're excited to share that a new patch has just gone live. It brings a host of fixes, usability improvements, and full support for both Chinese and Catalan languages.

This update also includes significant optimization work, especially for lower-end systems, resulting in performance boosts of up to 300%. Tormenture is also now fully compatible with Steam Deck, running smoothly at 60 FPS on Ultra settings.

[h2][b]Overview[/b][/h2]
[list][*]     Chinese & Catalan localization
[*]     Input remapping for both keyboard/mouse and gamepad
[*]     Major optimization improvements (up to +300% performance)
[*]     New zoom mechanic for small-screen visibility
[*]     General bug fixes and usability tweaks[/list]

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]

[h3][b][MENUS][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Added a new photosensitivity warning screen
[*]     Improved overall menu navigation and added a new "back" sound cue
[*]     Introduced a new Input Settings menu with sensitivity sliders and a full input remapping system[/list]
[h3][b][SAVE GAME][/b][/h3]
[list][*] Optimized save file handling to reduce read/write frequency[/list]
[h3][b][(3D) ROOM ENVIRONMENT][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Batteries now correctly disappear after use
[*]     Improved item grabbing system for better interaction with 3D objects
[*]     Fixed an issue where the wooden box wouldn’t open after inserting both pieces
[*]     Optimized visual fidelity of some environment objects
[*]     Enhanced behavior of book-type 3D items
[*]     Added extra zoom functionality when inspecting the Guess Who game[/list]
[h3][b][FOREST][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Minor layout adjustments
[*]     Fixed a potential softlock after the orange lock door[/list]
[h3][b][MANSION][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Improved clarity at the end of the Artist Room sequence[/list]
[h3][b][RUINS][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Fixed enemies occasionally moving through walls
[*]     Addressed visual glitches during the Ruins boss 3D sequence[/list]
[h3][b][CAVES][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Minor layout tweaks in several rooms
[*]     All interactables are now functional in darkness
[*]     Fixed a phone maze exploit that allowed players to bypass it
[*]     Resolved an issue where pushable blocks couldn’t be moved after being caught by a phone maze hand
[*]     Fixed abnormal behavior with blinds and ceiling lamps[/list]
[h3][b][MAZE][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Final Boss hitbox now behaves correctly during teleportation
[*]     Addressed a potential softlock during the second phase of the Final Boss[/list]
[h3][b][LOCALIZATION][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Multiple localization bugs fixed
[*]     Added full Catalan and Chinese language support[/list]
[h3][b][GLOBAL][/b][/h3]
[list][*]     Fixed an issue where items became ungrabbable if the currently held item was destroyed
[*]     Solved occasional music dropouts
[*]     Added subtitles in key moments to enhance understanding across languages
[*]     Massive performance improvements on lower-end systems (up to +300%)
[*]     Fully Steam Deck compatible, now running Ultra at 60+ FPS
[*]     Added a new zoom mechanic for better visibility of held 3D objects on smaller screens
[*]     Various other minor fixes and improvements[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]We’re excited to share that a new update for Tormenture is now live![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749585/6f4af7a27b7751787692441b18303c33f57c0a40.png[/img]

Thanks to our amazing community, we’ve [b]fixed different bugs[/b] and made [b]important tweaks[/b] based on your comments and reviews. Your input really helps us make the game better. Check out the detailed changelog at the end of this announcement.
 
We are humbled by the kind words you’ve shared in your reviews—they are [b]essential to the game’s success and visibility[/b] in the store. Thank you!
 

[h2]Overview[/h2]

[*] Soft-Locks
[*] Save system
[*] Bosses
[*] Map
[*] Other minor fixes


[h2]Change log[/h2]
 
[b][MENUS] [/b]

[*][b]Fixed the Easter Eggs pop-up[/b] that appeared at the beginning of the game.
 

[b][TUTORIAL] [/b]

[*]Fixed the [b]Dragon Enemy [/b]whose charge attack could cause it to[b] go off-screen.[/b]
 

[b][SAVE GAME] [/b]

[*]Fixed issues that caused save game loss, where the [b]"Continue" button would disappear upon returning to the main menu. [/b]

[*]Added a [b]backup system to restore corrupted save files.[/b]
 

[b][(3D) ROOM ENVIRONMENT] [/b]

[*][b]Added accessibility improvements[/b] for the Speak'n'Spell Item. Spelling words will now appear subtitled. 

[*]Fixed inconsistencies with the [b]3D models of notes.[/b]  

[*]Fixed issues when [b]lowering the blinds[/b] in the room. 

[*][b]Corrected an interaction issue[/b] with the plush toy after acquiring the Torch Item.
 

[b][HUB / MAP CENTER]  [/b]

[*]The [b]Lever Item will not disappear[/b] when the Player carries it out of the zone and drops it or continues after a game over. The Item will always return to its original location and can be retrieved via the river channel or by entering the Village Zone through the forest.
 

[b][MAP] [/b]

[*]Fixed issues related to [b]loading between zones. [/b]
 

[b][FOREST] [/b]

[*]Adjusted [b]sokoban mechanics to allow planting seeds[/b] after the sokoban has passed over them.
 

[b][MANSION] [/b]

[*]Adjusted the [b]Mirror Enemy in the Mansion Zone.[/b]
 

[b][RUINS] [/b]

[*]Fixed issues with the [b]Turret Enemy[/b] in the Ruins Zone. 

[*]Fixed the [b]hands of the Ruins Boss[/b] that were blocking progression to the next phase of the Boss fight. 

[*][b]The Tape Item[/b] in the Ruins Zone will no longer reappear after completing its puzzle.
 

[b][CAVES] [/b]

[*]Improved performance for the [b]Cave Boss. [/b]

[*][b]Adjusted the movement of the Lurker enemy[/b] in the Cave Zone. The enemy will no longer move if the game is paused or during its introductory scene. 

[*]Fixed the death animation of the [b]NPC “Big Head”.[/b]
 

[b][MAZE] [/b]

[*][b]Fixed an issue in the Maze[/b] where the player could pass through the [b]yellow door with the Small Dot [/b] Item, blocking their progress. 

[*][b]Adjusted the Bridge[/b] Item to prevent the player from getting stuck and allow it to be grabbed from a greater distance. 

[*][b]Various fixes in the first phase of the Final Boss[/b]. The Boss will no longer teleport outside the Gaming Area, and the sound of its attacks will not persist after a game over.

[h2]Known issues[/h2]

[*] Beware of using [b]Steam cloud saves across different devices[/b]. Please make sure you client has synchronized properly with the cloud [b]before starting the game[/b]
[*] Some people are experiencing a [b]black screen[/b] right at the begining of the game. This is caused by the NVidia Fast V-Sync option. Please set the Fast V-Sync option to off in the nvidia panel
[*] If for any reason you think you have lost your save game, please reach us at #tormenture-help in our Discord server (link available in the Steam page)

notes.title: Tormenture takes the Inscryption meta-horror formula back to 8-bit gaming and the 1980s
notes.content:
I forgot about just-launched horror game Tormenture when ravelling together this week's round-up of potent PC releases, but thankfully, Maw disciple Fachewachewa was on my case in the comments. It's one of your 'cursed video game' videogames in the spirit of Inscryption and Pony Island, and based on a quick blast with the demo, it seems lush.

It's set in the 1980s, a premise I now automatically find horrible because I was born in the 1980s and that was, like, a million years ago. You're a kid who's playing a legendary 8-bit game that's said to be possessed by evil spirits. The experience sees you alternating between the surprisingly labyrinthine space of the game, and the increasingly threatening environment of your bedroom, where terrible toys abound. Did you have one of those phones on wheels with eyes as a kid? Whoever invented that deserves a spell in Arkham Asylum.

Tormenture is now live and ready for you to experience! Step into a cursed horror game set in the 80s, where you’ll assume the role of a child drawn in by rumors of a haunted 8-bit video game. Legend has it that the developers made a deal with the devil for eternal life, leading to dire consequences.

To escape this digital horror, you must find and gather four relics while navigating a vast, interconnected map filled with puzzles that may reflect real-life challenges. Be wary of the sinister creatures lurking in the shadows, waiting to break free from the game.

This tribute to 8-bit classics transports you back to a child’s room filled with nostalgic toys like Speak’n Spell and Guess Who?, which will help you uncover hidden secrets. With retro gameplay and a haunting narrative, Tormenture invites you to unravel mysteries that blur the lines between reality and gameplay.

Do you have the courage to confront these unsettling trials and uncover the truth? Tormenture is available now on Steam—get ready for an unforgettable journey!

notes.title: Tormenture on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749585/734d03651319cce41915944e65c9fcd8e51ab6b0.png[/img]

Hello, Steam Deck users!

We've heard that some of you have questions about whether the game runs smoothly on Steam Deck. While we don’t have official verification from Steam [b]yet[/b], we’re excited to share some great news: here at Billete Cohete, we’ve conducted internal testing and can confirm that [b]we haven't encountered any issues with functionality or compatibility on Steam Deck![/b]

Although we are still awaiting official verification from Steam, rest assured that [b]Billete Cohete is actively working[/b] to secure this status for Tormenture.

We also want to remind you that [b]today marks the official launch of Tormenture[/b] here on Steam, and we hope you all enjoy the experience alongside us. We can't wait for you to have the game in your hands and to hear your thoughts about it.

We care deeply about providing our players with the best possible experience on all platforms, so we’ll be keeping a close eye on your feedback to improve as a publisher and ensure the best experience for you.

Thank you so much for being here, and we hope you enjoy [b]Tormenture[/b] on your Steam Deck!

The Billete Cohete Team.
